status: post-outcome generated mechanism analysis frozen after x-y-time structural preflight and before opening the new collective/personal 3D outcomes
role: separate post-freeze extension; cannot modify or rescue frozen JAE claims

lane_A_natural_turnover.membership_rule: night pairs share zero tracked individual identities
lane_A_natural_turnover.night_pooling: equal biological individual; within an individual-night use its session distribution
lane_A_natural_turnover.primary_metric: common-horizontal conditional vertical overlap O_Z_given_XY between pooled nights
lane_A_natural_turnover.null: within every individual-night independently permute complete conditional vertical-profile vectors among that session's occupied 500-m cells; horizontal occupancy, membership, local profile collection and all pair definitions remain fixed
lane_A_natural_turnover.support_rule: observed mean O_Z_given_XY minus null mean > 0 and one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
lane_A_natural_turnover.claim_if_supported: collective-level 3D configuration is spatially repeatable across naturally non-overlapping tracked membership

lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.history_rule: strictly past sessions at least 3 days before target
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.self_model: equal-session mean P(z|500-m cell) from focal-individual past
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.group_model: equal-individual mean of each other individual's equal-session P(z|500-m cell) past model
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.group_marginal_model: equal-individual mean of each other individual's equal-session marginal P(z) past model

scores.shared_group_gain: mean target log P_group(z|cell) - log P_group_marginal(z)
scores.personal_increment: mean target log P_self(z|cell) - log P_group(z|cell)
scores.total_personal_history_gain: mean target log P_self(z|cell) - log P_group_marginal(z)

lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.identity_check: total_personal_history_gain = shared_group_gain + personal_increment on exactly the same target fixes
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.aggregation: equal target session within biological individual, then equal biological individual
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap biological individuals with replacement
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.component_support_rule: panel mean > 0 and percentile 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0

claim_boundary: Lane A support is collective spatial persistence, not proof of social or cognitive memory; stable environmental geometry is an alternative.
Lane B shared-group gain is a cross-individual predictive template, not by itself colony memory.
Lane B personal increment quantifies information uniquely carried by focal-individual history beyond other-individual history.
No thresholds, panel sets, lag, grid, bins, weighting, null, bootstrap rule or classification may change after outcome opening.
